responsibility: Implements the vectorizer’s data-reference analysis and memory-access support for both loop and basic-block vectorization. This file analyzes loads, stores, access strides, groups, alignments, misalignment handling, gather/scatter-like forms and related target capabilities, chooses between aligned, unaligned, and realignment schemes, and provides utilities for deriving statement vector types from referenced scalar memory types and for creating or adjusting grouped memory operations used later by transformation code.
